summary: Masoom Minawala is a Mumbai-based entrepreneur, investor, and content creator with a focus on fashion, beauty, and lifestyle. A Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree, she founded Style Fiesta and currently operates as a global influencer working with luxury brands like Louis Vuitton and Dior. Her public persona blends high-end brand partnerships with educational content on personal branding and mental health, while her Instagram reveals a mother who values work-life boundaries and festive hosting.
